sources.document_title: TPS2663x 60V, 6A Power Limiting, Surge Protection Industrial eFuse
sources.locator: Table 5-1 Pin Configuration and Functions (VQFN column) page 3-4; Table 6.5 Electrical Characteristics rows UVLO/OVP/ILIM page 6-7; section 8.3.1-8.3.4
sources.evidence_extract: TPS26630 VQFN-24 (RGE): pins 1,2 IN; 3 B_GATE; 4 DRV; 5 IN_SYS; 6 UVLO; 7 OVP; 8 GND; 9 dVdT; 10 ILIM; 11 MODE; 12 SHDN; 13 IMON; 14 FLT; 15 PGTH; 16 PGOOD; 17,18 OUT; 19-24 N.C.; PowerPAD to GND plane, not the only GND connection. EC -40..125 C: V(IN_SYS) operating 4.5..60 V; V(UVLOR) 1.176/1.2/1.224 V, V(UVLOF) 1.09/1.122/1.15 V; V(OVPR) 1.176/1.2/1.224 V, V(OVPF) 1.09/1.122/1.15 V; I(OVP) leakage +/-150 nA; internal IN_SYS OVP 33.2..35.4 V (OVP to GND); internal UVLO 15.1..15.9 V rising (UVLO to GND). I(OL) at R(ILIM)=4.02 kOhm, VIN-VOUT=1 V: 4.185/4.5/4.815 A; TPS26630 fast-trip 2xI(OL); I(SCP) 45 A. MODE open = latch, MODE GND = auto-retry. PGTH to GND disables fast recovery turn-on and holds PGOOD low (8.3.2.1). tdVdT = 20.8e3 x V(IN) x C(dVdT) (Eq 2). Abs max IN, OUT, UVLO, FLT, PGOOD, PGTH -0.3..67 V.
